_comment: Mirror of Kafuo's closed action-adjacent vocabularies (Module 3/4 W6, TAE-RQ-036).
Provisioned from the sibling backend repo, exactly like the W7 digest vectors
(tests/fixtures/kafuo-digest-vectors.json): the backend owns the source of truth and
its own tests pin these enums; this mirror lets the Teaching Engine side assert the
two systems' vocabularies stay DISJOINT without a live cross-repo dependency.
Tutoring Answer Actions carry no closed enum on the Kafuo side
(tutoring_sessions answer_action_dtos.action_type is an open string; the chat
projection's message_type default "answer" is the one closed wire token), and
package commands are an HTTP surface, not a vocabulary — so neither contributes
more than the answer token mirrored here.
